ORIGINAL 2D miniboss source sheet for "Awakened Temple Guardian" in a colorful Sun-and-Moon temple mobile tower-defense game. Pure flat/cartoon 2D, chunky imposing proportions, clean dark outlines, saturated sandstone/gold/indigo/teal palette, soft cel shading, high phone readability. No 3D, no realism.

Character identity: ancient animated stone guardian with broad torso, two heavy stone arms, split sun/moon shoulder plates, teal crystal core in chest, simple expressive mask-like face carved into stone, trailing cloth ribbons in warm gold and cool indigo, no weapons.
Create 5 isolated consistent poses:
1 dormant kneeling statue,
2 awakening with crystal lighting,
3 active combat idle,
4 sweeping arm attack,
5 ground-slam attack.
Same anatomy/proportions/camera. No text, no UI, no extra characters.
